description.value: Trafiq Café & Bakery has been a fixture on Main Street in Vancouver's Riley Park neighbourhood since 2011, founded by a pastry chef formally trained in Belgian technique. The café is known for its handcrafted layered cakes, naturally leavened breads, and seasonal pastries — all made on-site — alongside made-to-order sandwiches and locally roasted coffee in a relaxed, 30-seat space with large sliding front windows. It is a genuine neighbourhood gathering spot rather than a chain, with a long-standing focus on hospitality and craft.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and fully accessible. Contact details (phone, address) match OSM exactly. The FAQ explicitly states no Wi-Fi ('No, we discovered many years ago that our place is best suited to conversation and disconnecting from our devices'). The café menu page confirms same-day pickup and Uber Eats delivery (takeout), and the menu/FAQ confirm vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free bread options. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, or water refill.
concerns: OSM name is 'Trafiq Cafe and Bakery' but the business's own website consistently uses 'Trafiq Café & Bakery' (accented é, ampersand instead of 'and').
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible café and bakery with an active website, confirmed contact details, and a broad food and drink offering well-suited to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu labels vegetarian items (V) and vegetarian options (VO); FAQ states breads and many spreads/sauces are naturally vegan and a full vegan sandwich can be built; gluten-free bread substitution offered on sandwiches

Wi-Fi.detail: FAQ explicitly states: 'No, we discovered many years ago that our place is best suited to conversation and disconnecting from our devices.'
